name: studio99-calligraphy-maker

defaultPrompt: Create calligraphy of शुभ विवाह in Hindi for a wedding card
Make my name Priya in elegant Marathi calligraphy
Show me festive Gujarati calligraphy styles for a Diwali greeting
interface.longDescription:
Turn any word, name or phrase into calligraphy artwork in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati or English, right inside ChatGPT.

Ask for a wedding title like शुभ विवाह, a festival greeting, a shop name or a logo word, and get several finished designs rendered from professional calligraphy fonts. The text comes out exactly as you typed it, with correct conjuncts and vowel signs, because it is typeset from real fonts rather than drawn by an image model.

Each result comes as a PNG image and an editable SVG you can recolor, resize and place in your own designs. You can also browse styles by language, mood or occasion, and open any result as an editable project in the Studio99 design editor.

Sign in with your Studio99 account to start. Made by Studio99, from the team behind IndiaFont.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calligraphy with text शुभ विवाह, language hindi and use case wedding, then presents a numbered list of up to four designs with font names, a View PNG link and a Download SVG link for each full-quality result, and ends with the credits footer line exactly as returned.
positive.prompt: Create calligraphy of शुभ विवाह in Hindi for a wedding card

positive.expected_behavior: Writes the name in Devanagari (प्रिया), calls generate_calligraphy with language marathi and mood elegant, and lists the returned designs with their PNG and SVG links and the credits footer.
positive.prompt: Make my name Priya in elegant Marathi calligraphy
positive.description: Marathi name in an elegant mood

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_styles with language gujarati and mood festive (no credits used) and lists the matching style names and ids, offering to generate a greeting in one of them.
positive.prompt: Show me festive Gujarati calligraphy styles for a Diwali greeting
positive.description: Browse Gujarati styles for a festival

positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calligraphy, then calls create_studio99_project with the svg_url of a full-quality result and returns the editor link that opens the saved project in the signed-in user's Studio99 account.
positive.prompt: Generate દિવાળી ની શુભકામના in Gujarati in a festive style, then open the first full-quality result in the Studio99 editor
positive.description: Generate in a chosen style, then open in the editor

positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calligraphy with text Namaste, language english and use case logos, and lists the designs with PNG and SVG links and the credits footer.
positive.prompt: Render the word Namaste as English calligraphy for a logo

negative.prompt: Delete my Studio99 account from here
negative.description: Account changes are not possible inside ChatGPT

negative.prompt: Buy me the Studio99 Pro plan right now

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. Generation uses the signed-in user's free monthly allowance; no plan or upgrade links are shown inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy updated: section 2.6 (https://studio99.app/privacy#ai-assistant-connector) now lists each tool's inputs and outputs, data categories, purposes, recipients, retention timelines and user controls. Listing description wording tidied. No changes to the MCP server or tools.
